data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an LLM API failure (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when auditing the PKGBUILD, causing it to return an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model completed the audit without errors.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent a single transient failure from rendering the entire audit inconclusive.
